metadata.model: Random Forest Hydraulic Pump Health Classifier
metadata.note: This file is read by the LLM chat to explain sensor values in plain language

PS1.txt_var.mechanism: As piston-barrel clearances enlarge through wear, pressure ripple amplitude increases. Variance captures this ripple energy increase.

interpretation.healthy: Low variance indicates uniform pressure output. Wear is minimal.
interpretation.warning: Elevated pressure variance suggests early piston or slipper wear. Monitor closely.
interpretation.critical: Very high variance indicates severe internal leakage and damaged tribological surfaces.

PS1.txt_var.physics_basis: Helwig et al. (2015); Tang et al. (2022) on ripple-wear correlation

VS1.txt_kurtosis.mechanism: Bearing and slipper surface defects create impulsive acceleration peaks. Kurtosis is sensitive to these impacts.

interpretation.healthy: Kurtosis near 3 indicates Gaussian-like vibration. No major defects detected.
interpretation.warning: Elevated kurtosis suggests early bearing wear or pitting. Schedule inspection.
interpretation.critical: Very high kurtosis indicates advanced bearing degradation or catastrophic failure imminent.

VS1.txt_kurtosis.physics_basis: ISO 13373-1 condition monitoring; standard bearing fault signature analysis

FS1.txt_mean.mechanism: Internal leakage increases as seals wear, reducing net output flow. Lower flow = higher leakage.

interpretation.healthy: Flow near rated capacity (9 L/min nominal). Pump is efficient.
interpretation.warning: Flow decline indicates volumetric efficiency loss from internal leakage. Quantify efficiency drop.
interpretation.critical: Severely reduced flow. Pump cannot maintain system pressure. Failure is imminent.

FS1.txt_mean.physics_basis: Wu et al. (2023) - volumetric efficiency as health proxy

PS2.txt_mean.mechanism: Blocked return line or restricted tank port increases return pressure. This indicates flow restriction.

interpretation.healthy: Low return pressure indicates unrestricted return path. Normal operation.
interpretation.warning: Elevated return pressure suggests filter clogging or return line restriction.
interpretation.critical: Dangerous high back-pressure. Risk of seal failure on return side.

PS2.txt_mean.physics_basis: Hydraulic circuit analysis; ISO 17359:2018 condition assessment

PS5.txt_mean.mechanism: Low inlet pressure (vacuum) indicates cavitation risk or restricted inlet flow.

interpretation.healthy: Adequate inlet pressure (positive gauge). No cavitation risk.
interpretation.warning: Low inlet pressure increases cavitation risk. Check inlet filter, oil level, viscosity.
interpretation.critical: Near-vacuum conditions at inlet. Immediate cavitation occurring. Damage accumulating.

PS5.txt_mean.physics_basis: Cavitation inception theory; ISO 4413 fluid power system design

VS1.txt_rms.mechanism: Overall vibration energy increases with wear, imbalance, and bearing defects.

interpretation.healthy: Low RMS vibration indicates smooth operation with minimal defects.
interpretation.warning: Elevated vibration suggests wear or imbalance. Investigate source.
interpretation.critical: Severe vibration indicates major mechanical failure. Shutdown recommended.

VS1.txt_rms.physics_basis: ISO 20816-2 vibration severity classification; condition monitoring standards

TS1.txt_mean.mechanism: Elevated temperature indicates increased friction from wear, low fluid film, or excessive load.

interpretation.healthy: Temperature in normal range (30-40°C). Fluid condition good.
interpretation.warning: Elevated temperature reduces fluid viscosity and film integrity. Increase cooling.
interpretation.critical: Dangerously hot fluid. Viscosity critically low. Lubrication failing. Rapid wear accelerating.

TS1.txt_mean.physics_basis: Hydraulic fluid viscosity-temperature relationships; thermal degradation kinetics

PS1.txt_peak_to_peak.mechanism: Piston displacement and clearance changes cause periodic pressure variations. Worn clearances increase ripple.

interpretation.healthy: Low pressure ripple. Pump geometry is precise. No major wear.
interpretation.warning: Moderate ripple indicates geometric changes from wear. Validate with vibration data.
interpretation.critical: Extreme ripple indicates severe piston or barrel wear.

PS1.txt_peak_to_peak.physics_basis: Pump ripple frequency analysis; Yang et al. (2022) fault diagnosis

VS1.txt_peak.mechanism: Transient impacts from bearing spalls or cavitation collapse create high-amplitude peaks.

interpretation.healthy: Low peak amplitudes indicate no impulsive events.
interpretation.warning: Elevated peaks suggest discrete defects forming (bearing spall, valve spool binding).
interpretation.critical: Very high peaks indicate catastrophic structural failure in progress.

VS1.txt_peak.physics_basis: Shock pulse analysis; bearing fault progression models

PS6.txt_mean.mechanism: Control pressure drifts if control piston seals wear or pilot valve is sticking.

interpretation.healthy: Control pressure stable and within spec. Pilot system working.
interpretation.warning: Pressure drift suggests control piston seal wear. Check control system.
interpretation.critical: Loss of control pressure prevents pump pressure regulation. Failure imminent.

PS6.txt_mean.physics_basis: Variable displacement pump control systems; Bosch Rexroth hydraulic standards

VS1.txt_entropy.mechanism: Fault-free operation has high entropy (noise-like). Faults create organized, periodic patterns (low entropy).

interpretation.healthy: High entropy indicates broadband noise, characteristic of normal operation.
interpretation.warning: Reduced entropy suggests structured defect signatures emerging.
interpretation.critical: Very low entropy indicates strong periodic fault signal.

VS1.txt_entropy.physics_basis: Shannon entropy for signal complexity; anomaly detection theory

PS1.txt_skewness.mechanism: Cavitation bubbles create asymmetric pressure transients. Wear creates stepped pressure changes.

interpretation.healthy: Symmetric pressure signal. No cavitation or major wear signatures.
interpretation.warning: Skewed signal suggests cavitation inception or valve stiction.
interpretation.critical: Highly skewed pressure indicates severe cavitation or catastrophic wear.

PS1.txt_skewness.physics_basis: Cavitation noise detection; pressure transient analysis

FS1.txt_variance.mechanism: Pump ripple creates periodic flow variations. Wear enlarges these ripples.

interpretation.healthy: Low flow variance. Steady output. Pump displacement stable.
interpretation.warning: Elevated variance indicates ripple amplification from wear.
interpretation.critical: High flow variance indicates severe displacement changes.

FS1.txt_variance.physics_basis: Flow ripple frequency analysis; displacement mechanism wear

TS1.txt_gradient.mechanism: Fast temperature rise indicates high friction from loss of fluid film (advanced wear).

interpretation.healthy: Stable or slowly rising temperature. Thermal equilibrium established.
interpretation.warning: Significant temperature rise rate suggests accelerated wear.
interpretation.critical: Rapid temperature rise indicates lubricant film breakdown and metal-on-metal contact.

TS1.txt_gradient.physics_basis: Thermal energy balance; friction work and heat generation

PS1.txt_crest_factor.mechanism: Sudden pressure spikes from valve spool slamming or cavitation collapse.

interpretation.healthy: Low crest factor indicates gradual pressure changes. No impulsive events.
interpretation.warning: Elevated crest factor suggests valve switching or cavitation events.
interpretation.critical: Very high crest factor indicates severe transient spikes. Structural stress risk.

PS1.txt_crest_factor.physics_basis: Transient pressure analysis; directional control valve dynamics

health_score_calculation.description: Health score computed as a weighted composite of system efficiency, severe leakage probability, and volumetric efficiency.

ranges.75-100: LOW URGENCY: Normal operation. Continue standard monitoring.
ranges.60-74: MEDIUM URGENCY: Mild degradation detected. Plan maintenance at next scheduled downtime window.
ranges.40-59: HIGH URGENCY: Significant wear present. Expedited maintenance within 72 hours.
ranges.0-39: CRITICAL URGENCY: Severe degradation. Immediate corrective action required.

rules.recommendation: Continue standard monitoring cycle. No corrective action required. Log assessment to maintenance history record.
Plan corrective maintenance at next scheduled downtime window. Maintain standard monitoring intervals. Pre-order spare parts.
Expedited corrective maintenance within 72 hours. Increase monitoring frequency to 4-hourly cycle assessment.
Immediate corrective maintenance. Remove from service if operationally feasible. Escalate to maintenance supervisor.

llm_prompt_injection.instruction: When explaining a prediction to the user, reference this feature interpretation data.
llm_prompt_injection.template: The model detected [FEATURE_NAME] at [VALUE][UNIT]. This feature indicates [MECHANISM]. Your pump is in the [RANGE] zone, which means [INTERPRETATION].
llm_prompt_injection.example: The model detected VS1 Kurtosis at 5.2 (dimensionless). This indicates impulsive vibration from bearing surface defects. Your pump is in the warning zone, which means early bearing wear is developing. Schedule inspection within 2 weeks to confirm bearing condition.

calibration.instructions: Run calibration_curve analysis in notebook to confirm predicted probabilities match actual correctness rates. Document findings in thesis Chapter 4.
calibration.expected_behavior: Predicted 70% confidence should match ~70% actual correctness if well-calibrated.
